# cubepath_availability_group (Resource)

Manages an availability group on CubePath Cloud. VPS instances in the same availability group are distributed across different physical hosts for high availability.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_name` (String) The location where the availability group operates (e.g., 'us-mia-1').
- `name` (String) The name of the availability group. Must be unique per project. Changing it forces a new group.
- `project_id` (Number) The ID of the project this availability group belongs to. Changing it moves the group in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the availability group. Changing it forces a new group.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the availability group was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the availability group.
- `max_servers` (Number) Maximum number of VPS that can be assigned to this group.
- `strategy` (String) The placement strategy. Currently always 'spread' (distribute VPS across different physical hosts).
- `vps_count` (Number) Current number of VPS assigned to this group.
